name: Webeyez Analytics
author: Webeyez

sections.description:
From small e‑commerce shops to big online retailers, Webeyez helps you connect business and technical performance. After installing the Webeyez plugin, you get full visibility into your business and technological performance. All goals are monitored automatically and you receive alerts about drops in the number of goal hits and how technology is affecting this count.

Webeyez gathers business and technological performance signals and presents them on the Webeyez platform.

It’s well known that technology performance directly affects business performance. A simple example is page load time—conversion rate drops and bounce rate increases with every added second of load time. Many tech issues affect business performance: downtime, call‑to‑actions that don’t work, server errors, browser errors, and more.

With Webeyez, we’ve got you covered. We monitor 100% of your real users’ business and technology performance, present current and historical performance, and alert you about anomalies in both business and tech performance.

For example, you can receive an alert about a drop in the number of orders caused by an increase in a specific server error.

Account & Pricing

You’ll need a Webeyez account to get started. Plans are based on the total number of monthly page views in your account. Webeyez is free for under 25K page views per month, with paid plans starting at $99 per month.

Features

  • Business Transaction Monitoring: Every user action on your site is recorded and presented in an intuitive way.
  • Business Transaction Alerting:
    • Anomaly Alert: Proprietary anomaly detection algorithms detect increases or decreases across all KPIs.
    • Threshold Alert: Set manual threshold alerts for each transaction (e.g., trigger an alert if add‑to‑cart drops by 30% over X hours vs. prior period).
  • Tech Monitoring: 100% of users’ technology performance is monitored. Analyze:
    • Page load time
    • Server time
    • Network time
    • JavaScript errors
    • Browser logs
    • Uptime monitoring
  • Tech Anomaly Detection: Automatic ML‑based anomaly detection on all tech metrics.
  • Tech Threshold Alerts: Define manual thresholds (e.g., alert if cart page load time exceeds 5 seconds).
  • Uptime: Be the first to know your site is down with downtime alerts.

Support

For help, contact our support team at support@webeyez.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings -> Webeyez Analytics screen to configure the plugin
